transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Hi. Um... well, I guess I'm just having a hard time organizing things lately. 

There are just... a lot of moving parts right now. Patent notes, workshop prep... gallery deadlines, team decisions. I just can't seem to organize it all anymore. I end up just starting whatever is loudest, I guess. Instead of what actually matters.
Did these organization problems start in childhood?

Yeah. Um... looking back, I guess it was there in grade school, too. My teachers used to write that I was bright but... that I daydreamed a lot. I'd forget to turn in assignments I'd actually finished. Or I'd just lose my homework folders. So... yeah. That was long before I was a teenager.
Do you often feel restless or have trouble sitting still?

Um... sometimes, I guess. Like... if I'm on a long design call. I just start feeling this... pressure building up in my body to get up. So I usually end up pacing around my office. Or... just shifting from chair to chair a lot. Even when I'm just trying to look focused.
Do you often make careless mistakes when doing tasks or work?

Yeah, I guess. Um... at work, doing code reviews, I'll sometimes miss... really small things. Stuff I shouldn't miss. 

Like a reversed condition, or... a version number in a dependency file. Later on, I can see it was right in front of me. I just... skimmed past it, I guess.
Do these attention and organization problems happen in more than one setting, like both at work and at home?
Um... yeah, I guess so. It's... it's not just at work. It happens at home, too.
